Village Vets Douglas

Just the loveliest people working here. Have been here twice now with my puppy Ozzie, and both times the visits have been spent sitting on the floor with him rather than stressing him out and putting him up on the table. The staff spend time getting to know him, making him comfortable, and spoiling him with treats before examining him. Even the woman on the front desk made a huge fuss of him and gave him loads of treats. The vets are highly professional and you can tell they're animal lovers. Really takes the dread of out vet visits! Can't recommend them enough.

I just wanted to edit my post to give particular thanks to Aoibheann who has been absolutely amazing looking after our cat who was recently diagnosed with AKI. The level of care has been so beyond appreciated. She’s truly gone above and beyond to help us and help our girl get back to health. Couldn’t recommend Douglas vets more, thank you for all of your help and assistance

We had our two kittens Kinder & Bueno neutered and microchipped at Village Vets in Douglas and the staff couldn’t have been kinder and more efficient. They had a pre neuter check and two follow up visits to check their progress which was excellent and all included in the price of the neutering. They were booked in on a Thursday morning and we had them back home that afternoon. They made a speedy recovery ❤️‍🩹 and we will be returning for all our future check ups or vaccinations etc. We were really happy with the service and the value for money.
Fantastic vets, what more can I say.
Staff top class. Always helpful and reassuring about what's happening with my pets

We have attended this practice for years. Declan, Elaine, Emma and all the team have always provided wonderful care and attention to all our dogs both past and present. We have always found them to be very professional, animal focused and kind and compassionate. We highly recommend them. Donie & Sandra.

The team at the clinic are very  caring and verv knowledgable making every visit a good experience. Thanks to Declan & his team. I would have no hesitation in recommending this clinic for any pet in need.
